w: During the evening assembly the Mayor of Edison -Mr. George Spadaro, Mayor of Franklin - Mr. Upendra Chivukula and other dignitaries and devotees welcomed and honored Swamishri.

Senior Citizens' Din The Southwest Satsang Mandal held a Senior Citizen's Day to give all elderly devotees an opportunity to offer their devotion to God. Senior Citizens got together to sponsor various activities throughout the day, including all meals and parayans, for which they received blessings from Swamishri.
